report:
Scope: e8667c85610d10882e7c33078748c7113b1c4a8e..f81d64cf15426e811195818c2a2072ac0f1827b6, restricted to the 12 literal fixture files supplied for batch 2 of seven, structural Important round 1. Every scoped file was read in full. HEAD matched the endpoint; working-tree changes were absent. No PR body was in scope, using the caller's verified absence of a PR. gh was not run.

Every path in excluded was omitted by the literal --files scope; dist paths are also generated. Relevant excluded files were read only as context. Nothing required by this batch remains unread.

Groups: code and docs through comments. Every applicable anti-pattern item was walked over every scoped file: Sibling input forms, Boundary arithmetic, Stale writes, Validator gaps, Absent or partial data, Untrusted data in commands, Tests that cannot fail, Crashes instead of reports, Unrun platform configuration, Unenforced trust boundary, Parallel paths, and Docs drift. Agent-prose control flow was inapplicable. Applicable Bash Important rules and secret-handling checks were also considered.

Sibling and consumer review covered notification shutdown and manifest assertions; both cancellation-child redirects and cancellation assertions; both ref-collision directions and shallow sources; ancestry cases and capture callbacks; Ruby and Perl socket startup with caller cleanup; both stat fallbacks and header assertions; GraphQL top-level versus nested errors; branch-validation consumers; corpus construction and mutation consumers; watch-request validation and refusal assertions; and the new guard fixture's sample copying, scanner invocation, Makefile registration and Scrut assertions.

The ledger and prior batch report were treated as historical data. They record no earlier findings for this fixture batch. No Important or Critical defect was established in the current scope, including pre-existing behavior examined during the full-file walk.

Mechanical checks run: none, as requested. Tests, lint, validation and mutation sensitivity remain unverified as listed in unverified. Historical passing results were not presented as current verification.

Session could write: no, enforced by the read-only filesystem sandbox. --run-checks: off. No repository scripts, mechanical checks, Codex runs or subagents were launched. No files or mailbox messages were written; nothing was left behind by checks. This session performed the review directly because the caller required it, excluding both Codex and subagent execution paths.

Complete static review of this batch: clean at Important. Runtime verification remains outstanding.
